Definition: Average gross domestic product per person in current USD
Expectation: Countries with larger GDP per capita have more records on GBIF

Definition: Total gross domestic product in current USD
Expectation: Countries with larger total GDP have more records on GBIF

Definition: Research and development expenditure as percentage of GDP
Expectation: Countries investing more in R&D have more records on GBIF

Definition: Number of full-time equivalent researchers per million inhabitants
Expectation: Countries with more researchers produce more biodiversity records

Definition: Absolute national spending on research and development in USD
Expectation: Countries with higher research expenditure generate more records

Definition: Total count of active researchers in the country
Expectation: Larger research workforce generates higher observation volume

Definition: Official development assistance specifically allocated to biodiversity projects in USD
Expectation: Countries receiving more biodiversity aid have more records on GBIF

Definition: Economic sub-index proxy measuring standard of living
Expectation: Countries with higher HDI have more records on GBIF

Definition: Health sub-index proxy measuring life expectancy at birth
Expectation: Higher health standards correlate with increased research activity and records

Definition: The most widely spoken primary language in the country
Expectation: Primary language affects accessibility and record representation on GBIF

Definition: Whether English is official or primary language spoken
Expectation: Countries with English as main language have more records on GBIF

Source: Pew Research Center / CIA World Factbook
Definition: Religion practiced by the majority of the population
Expectation: Religion influences data collection culture or attitudes toward natural history

Source: Pew Research Center / CIA World Factbook
Definition: Percentage of total population adhering to the main religion
Expectation: Religious homogeneity correlates with biodiversity data distribution

Definition: Percentage of population identifying as atheist or non-religious
Expectation: Higher secularism correlates with scientific research emphasis and open data

Definition: Colonization history status and identifying colonizing power
Expectation: Former colonizers have more records; colonized nations suffer historical record bias

Definition: Number of distinct terrestrial ecoregions within country borders
Expectation: Countries with more diverse biomes have more records on GBIF

Source: World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) / Natural Earth
Definition: Percentage of total national land area designated as protected (PA converted to %)
Expectation: Countries with more protected area percentage have higher record counts due to monitoring

Source: FAO Global Forest Resources / World Bank
Definition: Percentage of total land area covered by forests
Expectation: Countries with higher forest cover percentage have higher record counts

Definition: Absolute value of centroid latitude in degrees
Expectation: Countries closer to equator (lower latitude) have higher biodiversity and more records

Source: IUCN Red List / National Endemic Assessments
Definition: Count of endemic species found exclusively in that country
Expectation: Higher endemic species richness attracts more research interest and records

Definition: Total national population count
Expectation: Larger populations provide more potential observers and records on GBIF

Definition: Total land area of the country in square kilometers
Expectation: Larger countries have more diverse habitats and more records on GBIF

Definition: Number of people per square kilometer of land area
Expectation: Higher population density correlates with observer availability up to a threshold

Definition: Percentage of population living in urban areas
Expectation: Highly urbanized countries have greater digital connectivity and citizen science output
